rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency because the stored value is U_USD. The raw SOI presents the same investment schedule as dollar-denominated: the schedule is in thousands, cost/fair-value columns are the valuation columns, and schedule totals are explicitly marked with dollar signs. Source therefore supports USD denomination; the check appears to be rejecting a USD unit identifier rather than a non-USD unit.
